sloka: भगवन्मम वंशस्य शूलमेतदनुत्तमम् ।भवेत्तु सततं देव सुराणामीश्वरो ह्यसि ।। ७.६१.१२ ॥
transliteration: bhagavanmama vaṁśasya śūlametadanuttamam ।bhavettu satataṁ deva surāṇāmīśvaro hyasi ।। 7.61.12 ॥

translations.english: O Lord, may this excellent spear always remain with my lineage, for you are indeed the lord of the gods.
